evidence_quotes.O: As I'm sitting here writing this review, I'm listening to Beethoven's C minor string quartet (op. 18 No. 4), preformed by the Amadeus Quartet.
evidence_quotes.C: Having been warned by reading the other reviews, I checked the release pins before mounting a lens.
evidence_quotes.E: I have clients that come to my office and I was thinking that it would be nice to easily rotate the screen so that they could also see it.
evidence_quotes.A: Look at my history...I'm not above giving something a lousy review when it's warranted.
evidence_quotes.N: I am listening to this thing and it is driving me up a bloody tree (putting it politely).
